2608.07429.title: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents
2608.07429.paper_summary: Long-term memory enables language agents to reuse past facts, preferences, and task experience. Persistence also creates a central falsifiability problem: when the world changes, stale memories can remain retrievable and pollute the prompt. We characterize this failure mode as memory pollution: degradation caused by active memories that newer conflicting evidence has superseded. We introduce TEPA, a revocable evidence-memory mechanism that makes validity an explicit state of memory. TEPA represents observations as keyed precedents and revokes active precedents when fresh evidence contradicts them under the same key, allowing retrieval to draw from current evidence while preserving revoked history for audit. Across controlled hidden-regime drift, real file-backed executable drift, and preference-update streams, revocation prevents stale active memory from remaining in the retrieval set after reversal. In controlled drift over 50 seeds, append-only and last-write-wins memory fell below no memory during full reversal (append-only and last-write-wins both 0.210, no memory 0.309, TEPA 0.950), and the same pattern reproduced under real file execution (append-only 0.203, no memory 0.298, TEPA 0.950). On clean MemoryAgentBench SH-6k, TEPA matches a strong last-write-wins cache, confirming that current-key replacement is the decisive operation for single-hop fact consolidation. Boundary tests on multi-hop and very long-context MemoryAgentBench settings expose retrieval-chain and context-selection bottlenecks beyond fact-level validity tracking. Together, these results establish lifecycle revocation as a core memory operation for agents that must falsify, audit, and later re-promote evolving knowledge.
2608.07429.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶使語言代理能夠重複使用過去的事實、偏好和任務經驗。持久性還創造了一個中心的可證偽性問題：當世界發生變化時，陳舊的記憶可能仍然可檢索並污染提示。我們將這種失敗模式特徵化為記憶污染：由於活動記憶被更新的相互矛盾的證據所取代而造成的退化。我們引入TEPA，一種可撤銷的證據記憶機制，使有效性成為記憶的一種明確狀態。TEPA將觀察表示為鍵控的先例，並在新證據在相同鍵下與之矛盾時撤銷活動先例，允許檢索從當前證據中提取，同時保留撤銷的歷史以便審計。在控制的隱藏狀態漂移、真實文件支持的可執行漂移和偏好更新流中，撤銷防止了在反轉後陳舊的活動記憶仍然留在檢索集中。在50個種子的控制漂移中，僅附加和最後寫入勝利的記憶在完全反轉期間低於無記憶（僅附加和最後寫入勝利均為0.210，無記憶0.309，TEPA 0.950），在真實文件執行下重現了相同的模式（僅附加0.203，無記憶0.298，TEPA 0.950）。在乾淨的MemoryAgentBench SH-6k上，TEPA匹配一個強大的最後寫入勝利緩存，確認當前鍵替換是單跳事實整合的決定性操作。在多跳和非常長上下文的MemoryAgentBench設置上的邊界測試揭示了檢索鏈和上下文選擇的瓶頸，超出了事實級別的有效性跟踪。總體而言，這些結果確立了生命周期撤銷作為必須證偽、審計並隨後重新推廣不斷演變知識的代理的核心記憶操作。
